name: fix(cua): make Linux input delivery adaptive (#11876)
summary: Merged pull request making Linux Computer Use in the Qwen Code agent choose input delivery from the connected driver's platform.
description: Pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code. Linux Computer Use chooses input delivery from the driver's platform, so ordinary actions need no foreground/background mode: native X11 preparation preserves an already focused child, retries once within the deadline, and restores the previous window and child; the input callback still runs at most once. Updates the fixed Computer Use skill for OSWorld and prepares driver/SDK 0.20.8 and Node REPL 0.1.5.
contains: adaptive input delivery from the connected driver's platform
X11 preparation keeps a focused child, retries once, restores prior window and child
input callback runs at most once, including on partial or uncertain failures
prepares driver/SDK 0.20.8 and Node REPL 0.1.5; skill fixed for OSWorld
validation: 273 Linux native tests, 8 Xvfb scenarios, 3 GTK3/AT-SPI regressions
final ECS acceptance pending at submission (draft at maintainer request)
